<thought>I will retrieve polymorphs for a diverse set of nitride compositions using the batch tool, then consolidate the resulting JSON files into a single dataset and return its path.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
  "compositions": [
    "TiN", "VN", "ZrN", "HfN", "CrN", "MoN", "NbN", "TaN", "WN", "AlN",
    "GaN", "InN", "Si3N4", "BN", "Mg3N2", "Ca3N2", "Sr3N2", "Ba3N2",
    "Li3N", "Na3N", "K3N", "FeN", "CoN", "NiN", "CuN", "ZnN", "PdN",
    "PtN", "AgN", "AuN", "Sn3N4", "Pb3N4", "Ge3N4", "AsN", "SbN",
    "BiN", "YN", "LaN"
  ],
  "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
  "max_per_composition": 3,
  "save_directory": "nitride_polymorphs"
}</action_input>
